chunks: But then We never send the angels down save with the purpose (of enforcing their doom), after which they will not be given more respite.
ai.seo_question: Why are angels sent down only with the truth according to this verse?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Al-Mulk underscores the precision of divine justice, where angels descend not arbitrarily but strictly in accordance with the 'truth' (haqq) of Allah's decree. This specificity ensures that the respite granted to disbelievers is purposeful rather than indefinite, linking the immediate execution of judgment to the ultimate reality of the Hereafter. The verse serves as a reminder that divine punishment is never a surprise but the inevitable culmination of established cosmic laws.
